universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for text unless it is a main hero title.
Do NOT use standard blue for primary actions; use the Brand Violet.
Always use the 'data-testid' attribute for interactive elements.
Inputs in the Data Copilot must feel 'magical' - use larger padding, shadow, and rounded-full styles.
Tables should be clean: minimal borders, zebra striping is optional but ensure row hover states are clear.
For the 'Coming Soon' pages, use the 'abstract_bg' image with a glassmorphism overlay card.
Animations must be smooth (duration-300) and respect reduced-motion settings.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update tailwind.config.js with the new color palette and fonts. 2. Create a Layout component that includes the Sidebar and Topbar. 3. Implement the Data Copilot as the landing view or primary module. 4. Use Recharts for all data visualization, styling them to match the theme (no default colors). 5. Ensure the mobile view collapses the sidebar into a sheet/drawer.
